top_signals.title: Copper Retreats From Near Record as Traders Weigh Fed Outlook
top_signals.summary: Industrial metals fell, with copper retreating from near-record levels, as traders weighed the outlook for US interest rates amid shifting oil prices and comments from Federal Reserve officials.

top_signals.title: Eurobarometer survey shows overwhelming public support for European agriculture and EU support for farmers and rural areas
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 22 Sep 2026 According to the latest Eurobarometer survey, 95% of Europeans consider agriculture and rural areas important for Europe's future, while 93% say that securing a stable food supply for the EU is crucial.

top_signals.title: Joint press release: Commission and EIB Group launch European Institutional Investors Pact to boost investment in European tech scale-ups
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 22 Sep 2026 The European Commission and the European Investment Bank (EIB) Group launched today the European Institutional Investors Pact (EIIP) at the TechEU Equity Summit.

top_signals.title: Europeans are doing more physical activity, new Eurobarometer shows
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 22 Sep 2026 Today, on the eve of the European Week of Sport 2026, the European Commission published the sixth Eurobarometer on sport and physical activity. The survey shows an increase in physical activity levels across the European Union compared to the last survey published in 2022.

top_signals.title: Typhoon Dujuan leaves at least nine dead and four missing near Tokyo
top_signals.summary: Chiba Prefecture reported six deaths while Kanagawa Prefecture reported three as of 8 a.m. Wednesday. Two people are missing in each prefecture.
